notes: No horizontal scroll or clipped content at any width (checked 375px hardest per the checklist); single quiet column, generous spacing, calm agenda at all three widths.
Match names read in full across two lines where needed (e.g. 'National Bank Open presented by Rogers', 'Arsenal – Manchester City') — no mid-word truncation hiding a team or side.

Every event shows a where-to-watch line and all channels are Norwegian (NRK, TV 2 Play, VG+ Sport, Viaplay, Direktesport/Avisa Nordland, EuroVolley.tv, Chess.com, YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club), HBO Max (Sport)) — no FOX/ESPN/Sky seen. The National Bank Open and Cincinnati Open rows correctly show an honest faint '–' for an unknown channel instead of guessing.
Times present and sensibly formatted (e.g. '18:00', '13:40'); competition/round context shown under each fixture (e.g. 'UEFA Champions League 2026/27 (kvalifisering)', 'FA Community Shield 2026').

National flags and club crests render as real icons, not broken-image placeholders — verified at 3x zoom crops: Norwegian flag (EM friidrett), Brann, Rosenborg, KFUM Oslo, Alavés, Sevilla, Aalesund, Arsenal, Molde, Sarpsborg 08, Racing Santander, Espanyol, Fredrikstad, Celta Vigo, Deportivo. Must-see accent dots used sparingly (EM friidrett, Sandvolleyball-EM, Rosenborg–Viking, Molde–Tromsø, Brann–HamKam), not on every row.
Header, day headings, footer, and 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures all intact and aligned at every width.

The floating Assistent button rests over a mid-agenda row (the 'Apollon Limassol – Brann' row at 375/393px) — DESIGN.md-sanctioned (WP-146 variant D), not flagged. It does not cover the last agenda row or the footer at any width. At 900px it sits in the empty margin beside the centered 640px column, overlapping nothing.
